OUTSIDE SILHOUETTE ALPHA ZERO, inside silhouette solid opaque colors. Only twelve well-separated full-body sprites on exact regular 4x3 layout. Original character appearance is approved, do not redesign.
notes: Body sheets contain no weapons; weapon sheet separate. Generated spacing/scale/motion require inspection. Does not claim active gameplay replacement.
